critique: The render now has an appropriate black field, white particulate color, broad full-frame coverage, and clear slow population/motion from t1 to t4. It is much closer to the Floating Dust direction than prior iterations. However, it still reads primarily as a fine starfield: most grains are hard sub-pixel pinpoints rather than a consistently soft suspended-dust layer. The t1 field is also visibly less established than t4, so the opening frame does not yet feel like the preset's enveloping dust atmosphere.

suggestions.why: Raise the particle-size ceiling modestly so more of the very fine points resolve as soft dust grains instead of crisp star-like pixels.
Reduce extreme size randomness so the field has more consistently visible mid-fine dust while retaining some foreground/background variation.
